rules: E erases a block of 1s leftwards: `0 1^n E>1` becomes `E>0 0^(n+1)`.
F fills a run of 0s rightwards with 1s.
D crosses pairs `1 1` rightwards, rewriting each as `1 0`.
E on a separator 0 walks left through a block of 1s, moving the block one cell right.
halts: The all-ones left counter of 4 bits with the right block at the top bit: `1^10 0 1^10 B>0`.
The all-ones left counter of 5 bits with the right block at the top bit: `1^12 0 1^13 B>0`.
The all-ones left counter of 6 bits with the right block at the top bit: `1^14 0 1^16 B>0`.
